suggestions.U: The system shall present exactly three mutually exclusive options when the user initiates Save-Inspection: 1) skip recalculation, 2) prompt user and recalculate only after explicit confirmation, 3) recalculate automatically without prompt.
suggestions.A: Add priority rule: If option 2 and 3 are both configured, option 2 shall take precedence.
suggestions.V: Each option shall complete its workflow within 1 second and produce an audit log entry containing old-value, new-value, timestamp.

issues.evidence: give option to re calculate before update /save ... recalculate silently when user saves
issues.rewrite: Add exclusive-gateway: only one option shall be executed per save event; if multiple options are enabled, option 2 shall override option 3.
The prompt shall contain 'Recalculate' and 'Cancel' buttons; system shall recalculate only after the user clicks 'Recalculate' within 5 seconds.
